summary.title: [Testing][Medium] Browser suite is tied to one developer’s absolute checkout path
summary.one_line_description: The Playwright server always serves /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/dist, so the required browser suite fails or tests the wrong build from any other checkout path.

bug_1.file_locations: - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/playwright.config.ts - Playwright webServer configuration, Lines 16-20 - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/package.json - script: test, Lines 11-13

issue_description.description: The default pnpm test command invokes Playwright, whose webServer command contains the author’s absolute macOS checkout path. A clone on another machine, a second worktree, or a CI runner still asks Python to serve /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/dist. When that directory does not exist, the health check never receives the built site and the suite times out. If that path exists but belongs to a different checkout, the tests can pass against stale or unrelated output instead of the current repository. This breaks the documented default completion gate and makes browser verification non-portable.
issue_description.expected_vs_actual: | Aspect | Expected | Actual | |--------|----------|--------| | **Checkout portability** | pnpm test serves the current checkout’s dist directory | The command always serves /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/dist | | **CI behaviour** | Browser tests start after the current build | The web server points at a path absent from normal CI runners and cannot become healthy | | **Test integrity** | Assertions inspect output produced by the repository under test | Another checkout’s output can be served when the hard-coded path exists |
